result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a major layout problem with content being cut off at the bottom, and two minor issues including a typo and truncated card content.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza) in the 'Popular right now' section is vertically cut off, with only the top portion visible within the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the section or container height and bottom padding so the card is fully visible, or ensure the scrollable area extends to the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: Search placeholder contains a typo: 'Restarants' instead of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list is partially cut off at the right edge and the restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient right padding to the horizontal scroll container so the peeking card is intentionally clipped with proper spacing, and ensure long names truncate with ellipsis.
